name: @tetherto/swarm-deploy
description: Secure resumable artifact uploads over Hyperswarm

scripts.lint: prettier . --check && lunte src test && npm run test:types
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod 755 dist/bin/swarm-deploy.js
scripts.test:node: npm run build && npm run build:test && brittle-node .test-dist/run.js
scripts.test:bare: npm run build && npm run build:test && brittle-bare .test-dist/run.js
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:bare
scripts.validate:package: node -e "const a = require('node:assert/strict'); const f = require('node:fs'); const p = require('./package.json'); a.equal(p.name, '@tetherto/swarm-deploy'); a.equal(p.version, '0.1.0'); a.equal(p.private, undefined); a.deepEqual(p.publishConfig, { access: 'public', provenance: true }); a.deepEqual(p.engines, { node: '>=22 <25' }); a.equal(p.repository.url, 'git+https://github.com/tetherto/swarm-deploy.git'); a.equal(p.scripts.prepare, undefined); for (const value of [p.main, p.types, ...Object.values(p.exports['.'])]) a.match(value, /^\.\/dist\//); a.equal(p.bin['swarm-deploy'], 'dist/bin/swarm-deploy.js'); for (const file of [p.main, p.types, p.bin['swarm-deploy']]) a.ok(f.existsSync(file), file); f.accessSync(p.bin['swarm-deploy'], f.constants.X_OK)"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run test:types && npm run validate:package
